stages.name: Observe
stages.instruction: Drag $F'$ along the optical axis. Watch how the focal length $f'$ and the vergence $C$ move together — and notice that the lens itself grows thicker as the focal length shrinks.
stages.concept: For a thin converging lens, vergence is $C = 1/f'$, with $f'$ in metres and $C$ in dioptres ($\delta = \mathrm{m}^{-1}$). A shorter $f'$ means a larger $C$ and a physically thicker lens.

stages.name: Experiment
stages.instruction: Three target focal points appear one at a time on the axis. Drag $F'$ onto each target, then press SET (or Space) to lock it in. You have 5 shots for 3 targets.
stages.concept: Every focal length carries a matching vergence: $C = 1/f'$. Aim your $F'$ at the target tick — the vergence follows the position automatically.

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.instruction: The focal marks are hidden. Only the target vergence $C^*$ is given. Compute $f'^* = 1/C^*$ on paper, drag $F'$ to that focal length using the live $f'$ readout, then press SET. One shot per target.
stages.concept: Vergence-to-focal-length inversion: given $C^*$ in dioptres, the required focal length is $f'^* = 1/C^*$ in metres, or $f'^* = 100/C^*$ in centimetres.

labels.exhausted: OUT OF SHOTS · RESET TO RETRY
labels.tip1: drag F' — watch f' and C move together
labels.tip2: align F' with the target tick, then SET
labels.tip3: compute f' = 1/C on paper, then SET
labels.peek_strategy: f' (cm) = 100 / C — verify against your live f'

1.1: Grab the F' marker on the right and slide it along the axis.
1.2: As f' shrinks, C grows — they are inverses of one another.
1.3: The relation is C = 1/f' with f' in metres. Example: f' = 0.10 m gives C = 10 diopters.

2.1: Line up your F' with the orange target tick, then press SET.
2.2: The C readout in the HUD updates as you drag — use it to double-check.
2.3: If the target reads f'* = 10 cm, drag until your live f' reads 10.0 cm, then SET.

3.1: Read the target C* from the HUD. That is your only clue.
3.2: Convert: f'* (in metres) = 1 / C*, or f'* (in cm) = 100 / C*.
3.3: Drag F' until the live f' readout equals your computed target, then press SET.
